identity.name: research.select_opportunity
identity.summary: Consolidate searched ideas, form evidence-linked opportunity assessments against the Research Brief, and return the top eligible opportunity with a complete deterministic ranking record.

inputs.name: idea_set
inputs.description: The searched candidate ideas and the evidence passages and sources they cite.

inputs.name: research_brief
inputs.description: The objective, scope, and constraints candidates must answer.

outputs.name: opportunity_card
outputs.description: The selected opportunity and the ordered score and eligibility record for every consolidated candidate.

checks.description: Every input idea occurs in exactly one consolidated candidate; every output idea id, citation and chunk reference resolves to the idea_set; score rows cover the consolidated groups exactly once; and the selected card equals the first eligible row.
checks.author: muk

checks.description: On each fixture, the consolidated assessments and final opportunity card match the expected reference values.
checks.author: muk

evolution.notes: Only offline implementation optimization preserving the rank reference contract and conditional text mutation are allowed; checks, dependency policy, output schema and Gate rubrics remain protected.
